title: Connect an Agent offers the claude.ai and cloud-task steps on a deployment those clients cannot reach, with only a line of small print
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order. Asked 「用浏览器试一下，目前连接智能体系平台最核心的功能是否建议优化相关的界面以及把这个菜单放到更明显的位置」, then on the walkthrough's suggestions: 「都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-06). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Connect an Agent on `main` `04f36b63f8` (the widget and its page metadata are unchanged on `8b9cc712ab`), as an administrator and as a member, on a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** A company trying the platform on an internal server follows the claude.ai card, pastes the address, and the connection fails with no reason they can act on. The page knows the address it is showing and could say so first.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev, in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`: the claude.ai half of the Claude card (static note at line 274) and the 豆包工作 card (static note at line 347). The address is already in hand (`mcpUrl`, from `/discovery`).

**Duplicates.** Searched `Connect an Agent reachability` (93 hits). #16815 and #16882 (closed) corrected the copy that promised Claude Desktop reaches an intranet deployment; this card is about the page reacting to the address it shows. #26472 (open) is the server's http issuer mismatch, a different defect.

## Measured

On a deployment answering at `http://localhost`, the claude.ai / Claude Desktop column shows the address with a copy button and, below it in small print, that claude.ai connects from Anthropic's servers and needs public HTTPS. 豆包工作 has the same kind of note for cloud tasks. Nothing on the cards changes with the address.

## Expected

When the address is not public HTTPS (an `http://` address, `localhost`, or a private network address), the claude.ai path and Doubao's cloud tasks are marked as not available for this deployment, with the reason in one sentence and what makes them available (a public HTTPS address). The local clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) stay as they are. On a public HTTPS address nothing changes.
